Evelynn

Jungle Sleeper

On-hit AD Evelynn

How to play this build

Use stealth to appear behind the carry and explode with Trinity + Blade on-hit; instead of pure burst, you want sustained DPS. Gank lanes with no vision and use the ult to escape if a pick goes wrong.

Skill order

Max priority:

E Embestida → Q Púa de Odio → W Sigilo Oscuro

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
Ravage (E) for the on-hit steroid that boosts your autos; unlike AP Eve who maxes Q. Q second for waveclear.

Items and what they do

  1. Blade of the Ruined King % max-health on-hit and lifesteal; active steals move speed. Melts tanks.
  2. Trinity Force All-in-one: AD, attack speed, crit, health, mana, move speed and the Sheen proc.
  3. Wit's End Attack speed and MR; magic on-hit that also steals the target's MR.
  4. Mercury's Treads Boots with MR and tenacity (reduced CC duration).
  5. Frozen Mallet Lots of health and some AD; your auto-attacks slow the target (permaslow).

Runes

In Season 3, runes were a system SEPARATE from masteries: bought with IP (Influence Points) and slotted into 4 tiers — Marks (red), Seals (yellow), Glyphs (blue) and Quintessences (purple, the strongest). They gave flat stats: damage, armor, penetration, etc.

Marks (red) Attack damage ×9
Seals (yellow) Armor ×9
Glyphs (blue) Magic resist per level ×9
Quintessences (purple) Attack speed ×3

AD marks, armor, attack speed quints

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
21/9/0 — Offense
Why this page
21/9/0 gives damage and durability to duel up close, not just assassinate and flee.
